# ciphertrust_cm_users_list (Data Source)

Reads a list of CipherTrust Manager users. Returns all users when `filters` is omitted, or a filtered subset when `filters` is specified.

## Usage Notes

- **`depends_on` is required** when used alongside a `ciphertrust_user` resource in the same configuration. Without `depends_on`, Terraform may read the data source before the user is created, returning stale results:

  ```terraform
  data "ciphertrust_cm_users_list" "all" {
    depends_on = [ciphertrust_user.my_user]
    filters    = { username = "alice" }
  }
  ```

- `password` in each `users[*]` entry is always empty — CM does not return credentials in list responses.


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Key-value pairs forwarded as query parameters to the CM `/v1/usermgmt/users/` endpoint. Common keys: `username`, `email`, `name`. Example: `filters = { username = "alice" }` queries `/v1/usermgmt/users/?username=alice`.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) List of users returned by CM. Empty when no users match the specified filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The user's email address.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the user (same as `user_id`).
- `is_domain_user` (Boolean) Whether the user is a domain user.
- `name` (String) The user's full name.
- `nickname` (String) The user's nickname.
- `password` (String) Always empty — CM does not return credentials in list responses.
- `password_change_required` (Boolean) Whether the user must change their password on next login.
- `prevent_ui_login` (Boolean) Whether the user is blocked from logging in via the UI.
- `user_id` (String) Unique identifier of the user as assigned by CipherTrust Manager.
- `user_metadata` (Map of String) Arbitrary metadata associated with the user.
- `username` (String) The user's login name.
